segments.text: This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everybody arrives with a different idea of what a vacation should be, and almost all of them have to change it.
segments.tts_text: [a warm storyteller inviting the listener into the story] This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everybody arrives with a different idea of what a vacation should be, and almost all of them have to change it.

segments.text: Phil wants Hawaii to become the honeymoon he and Claire never had. They got married quickly at a courthouse because Claire was pregnant with Haley, so Phil sees this as a chance to finally do the romantic version properly.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Phil wants Hawaii to become the honeymoon he and Claire never had. They got married quickly at a courthouse because Claire was pregnant with Haley, so Phil sees this as a chance to finally do the romantic version properly.

segments.text: Claire points out that traveling with three kids doesn’t feel like a honeymoon. To her, it’s a business trip with nicer weather.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller building gentle suspense] Claire points out that traveling with three kids doesn’t feel like a honeymoon. To her, it’s a business trip with nicer weather.

segments.text: Phil gets her to leave the kids with Mitchell and Cameron and go to the adults-only pool. Claire slowly starts to relax. Then Haley shows up and says she wants to go to another hotel with teenagers she just met.

segments.text: Claire wants to follow her, but Phil talks her into trusting Haley and letting go for once.
segments.tts_text: [an animated storyteller explaining the scene] Claire wants to follow her, but Phil talks her into trusting Haley and letting go for once.

segments.text: A few hours later, Alex tells them Haley is upstairs drunk and throwing up. Claire is furious with herself for ignoring her instincts. She looks after Haley and reminds her how lucky she is that nothing worse happened.

segments.text: When Haley asks if drinking always makes you feel this terrible, Claire says yes without hesitation. It’s not exactly true, but Claire is happy to let her believe it.

segments.text: Phil’s honeymoon idea seems finished, but he has one last surprise. He realizes the thing they really missed wasn’t the honeymoon—it was the wedding. He arranges a small ceremony at the hotel, and the whole family gathers while Phil and Claire renew their vows.

He realizes the thing they really missed wasn’t the honeymoon—it was the wedding. He arranges a small ceremony at the hotel, and the whole family gathers while Phil and Claire renew their vows.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay starts the trip wanting to eat, drink, and do nothing. Then his brother reminds him that their father died at sixty-three, Jay’s age now. That scares him. Suddenly Jay is working out, swimming, rowing, and eating healthy food like he can reverse aging in a weekend.

segments.text: Gloria gets annoyed because he’s turning the vacation into boot camp. Jay pushes too hard and throws out his back getting into a hammock. Phil finds him stuck there, and Jay admits he’s scared of dying at the same age his father did.

segments.text: Gloria understands, but reminds him that staying alive should still include enjoying himself.

segments.text: Mitchell has the opposite problem. He wants to sightsee every minute, while Cameron wants to lie by the pool. Cameron has actually been pretending for years that he loves adventurous travel because Mitchell loves it.

segments.text: Mitchell goes to a lavender farm alone, comes back annoyed, and even invents a story about meeting Elton John to make Cameron jealous.

segments.text: Later, Mitchell finally tries Cameron’s version of vacation. He sits down, gets a drink, puts his feet up, and discovers that doing nothing feels amazing. Unfortunately, they get so relaxed that they accidentally leave Lily in an elevator. Gloria finds her and brings her back.

segments.text: Later, at a banana plantation, they lose her again.

segments.text: The trip is messy: Haley makes a stupid choice, Jay scares himself, and Mitchell and Cameron literally lose their baby twice. Somehow Phil still manages to end it with the wedding he and Claire never had.
